Range with at least one bound
Fixed chance from 0 to 1.
Randomly selected chance range.
A record ID to apply with a count of one.
Fixed item count with an implicit 100% chance.
Fixed item count.
Random count range.

count.description: Number of items to apply, or a random range.

chance.description: Chance to apply this item entry.

oneOf.description: Item count and optional chance roll.
Record IDs mapped to counts.

transform_type.description: Whether transformations should be applied relative to existing values (default) or as absolute replacements

oneOf.description: Fixed number of objects.
Random count range.

count.description: Number of objects to spawn from this pool, or a random range.

transform_type.description: Whether position/rotation/scale overrides are relative to the trigger object's values (default) or absolute.

createAction.description: Map of record IDs to spawn details. Each pool is evaluated independently (unlike replace, which picks one winner). Values can be a bare record ID (spawn 1), an integer count, or a full create pool config with chance and transform overrides.

oneOf.description: Spawn 1 copy at trigger position.
Spawn this many copies at trigger position.

chance.description: Probability 0-1 that this action block fires. When omitted, always fires.

add.description: Queues one or more items to be added to the current action target's inventory when the target is an Actor or Container.

remove.description: Removes one or more items from the current action target's inventory when the target is an Actor or Container and the requested count is available.

equip.description: Queues forced OpenMW UseItem for one or more items on the current action target when the target is an Actor, creating and moving the requested count into inventory first when missing. Equippable items equip; consumables or usable items may be consumed/used by OpenMW.

unequip.description: Queues forced OpenMW UseItem for one or more currently equipped matching items on the current action target when the target is an Actor. The requested count must already be equipped; missing items are not created.

chance.description: Probability from 0 to 1 that this action applies.

disable.description: Disable the action target after any replacement or transform actions in this rule. If paired with replace, this disables the replacement. When an object with chance is given instead of true, the action applies only when the random roll succeeds.

delete.description: Queue removal of the matched source object after any replacement or transform actions in this rule. If paired in the same action table with replace, removal is queued only when that replacement succeeds.

create.description: Spawn objects at the trigger's position. Each pool (record ID) is evaluated independently with optional count, chance, and position/rotation/scale overrides per pool. Transform overrides within a pool re-randomize per object for scatter/spread effects.

lock_level.description: Lock or unlock the target object. Positive values lock at that level. Zero or negative values unlock. Non-lockable objects (statics, creatures) no-op.

oneOf.description: Remove the key from the object.
Ordered key entries (single-key chance tables). First entry whose chance passes wins.

key.description: Set or remove the key on a lockable object. Non-lockable objects no-op.

oneOf.description: Remove the trap from the object.
Ordered trap entries (single-key chance tables). First entry whose chance passes wins.

trap.description: Set or remove the trap on a lockable object. Non-lockable objects no-op.

owner.description: NPC record ID to set as owner.

faction.description: Faction ID to set as owner.

set_ownership.description: Set ownership on the target object. All fields optional.

oneOf.description: Sound record ID to play.

file.description: VFS path to a sound file.

oneOf.description: 3D positional sound at target. Requires id or file.

playsound.description: Play 3D positional sound at the target object.

exteriorGridList.description: One or more exterior grid coordinates. This must be an array because table-valued condition payloads are treated as OR-lists by the loader.

cell_match.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the object's cell name or cell ID.

not.description: Invert a single inner condition. The value is a condition table like {nameMatch: "Guard"} — the inner condition is evaluated and the result negated.

quest.description: Quest ID to check the journal index of.

has_journal.description: Check whether the player's journal stage for a quest is within the given range. At least one of index/min/max is required.

oneOf.description: Check if object has any trap set.
Trap spell ID to match exactly.
Match any of the listed trap spell IDs.

has_trap.description: Gate by object trap state. Non-lockable objects return false.

oneOf.description: Check if object has any key set.
Key record ID to match exactly.
Match any of the listed key record IDs.

has_key.description: Gate by object key state. Non-lockable objects return false.

has_lua_script.description: Lua script path(s) attached to the object. Exact match against VFS path.

has_mwscript.description: MWScript record ID(s) on the object. Exact match, case-insensitive. Returns false when no MWScript is attached.

oneOf.description: Check if the object is locked or unlocked.
Object must be locked at this level or higher.
Lock level range. Object must be locked. At least one of min/max required.

locked.description: Gate by object lock state. Non-lockable objects return false.

oneOf.description: Player must be at least this level.
Player level range. At least one of min or max is required.

player_level.description: Gate by player level. Bare number means at-least.

target_level.description: Gate by target object level. Bare number means at-least, table with min/max for range. Non-actors return false.

oneOf.description: Minimum modified attribute value.
Modified attribute range.

player_attribute.description: Player modified attribute checks. Keys are attribute IDs (strength, intelligence, etc.). All entries must pass (AND).

oneOf.description: Minimum modified skill value.
Modified skill range.

player_skill.description: Player modified skill checks. Keys are skill IDs (longblade, destruction, etc.). All entries must pass (AND).

oneOf.description: Minimum modified attribute value.

target_attribute.description: Target actor modified attribute checks. Non-actors return false.

oneOf.description: Minimum modified skill value.

target_skill.description: Target NPC modified skill checks. Non-NPCs return false.

player_health.description: Player current health gate. Bare number means at-least.

player_spell.description: Spell ID(s) the player must know. Exact match.

target_spell.description: Spell ID(s) the target must know. Non-actors return false.

target_health.description: Target current health gate. Non-actors return false.

target_magicka.description: Target current magicka gate. Non-actors return false.

target_fatigue.description: Target current fatigue gate. Non-actors return false.

time_of_day.description: Game hour gate. Bare number means at-least, table with min/max for range. Hour is a 0-23 float.

faction_owner_id.description: Faction that owns the object. Case-insensitive exact match against owner.factionId. Returns false when no faction owner is set.

owner_id.description: NPC that owns the object. Case-insensitive exact match against owner.recordId. Returns false when no owner is set.

faction_owner_rank.description: Required rank for the faction that owns the object. Bare number means at-least. Returns false when no faction owner is set.

faction.description: Faction ID to check membership of.

player_faction.description: Player faction membership. At least one of rank/min/max is required. Returns false if player is not in the faction.

faction.description: Faction ID to check membership of.

target_faction.description: Target NPC faction membership. Same shape as player_faction. Non-NPCs return false.

target_class.description: Target NPC class ID. Exact match, case-insensitive. Non-NPCs return false.

player_equipped.description: Record ID(s) to match against any item equipped by the player. Exact match.

oneOf.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the current weather name. The literal value "none" matches when no weather is active (interiors, transitions).
Match any of the listed weather name substrings. Include "none" to match when no weather is active.
Match by storm flag and/or weather name substring. At least one of isStorm or name is required; when both are present both must match.

current_weather.description: Gate by current weather in the player's cell.

content_file_target.description: Map of content file names to reference numbers within that file. The object must originate from the specified content file AND have a matching reference number. All keyed content files are OR-ed; all reference numbers within a matched content file are OR-ed.

once.description: Whether to process this rule only once per object.

priority.description: Module load order tier. Lower runs first. cleanup (remove/disable only), foundation (structural), remodel (mesh/models), balance (stats/difficulty), standard (default), polish (cosmetic), finisher (last).

once.description: When true, the entire module only processes each object once across all rules. After any rule in the module applies to an object, no further rules from this module will be evaluated for that object.

replace_names.description: Optional list of cell names to replace objects within. If replace_names, exterior_cells, and replace_regions are all omitted from a static module, replace_meshes applies in every cell.

exterior_cells.description: Optional list of exterior cell coordinates to replace objects in. If exterior_cells, replace_names, and replace_regions are all omitted from a static module, replace_meshes applies in every cell.

replace_regions.description: Optional list of exact, case-insensitive cell region IDs/names to replace objects within. Region filters are ORed with replace_names and exterior_cells.

ignore_records.description: List of records to ignore when replacing objects for this module

replace_meshes.description: Mapping of old mesh paths to replacement mesh paths. With no replace_names, exterior_cells, or replace_regions filters, this mapping is unconditional and applies in every cell.

instances.description: Ordered rules for specific object replacement or transformation
